generalization_boundary.rationale: The validation pool is derived from the Tiki Books v4 Kaggle archive (CC0-1.0). While ID-disjoint and work-group disjoint from the 200-product development snapshot, it belongs to the same source family and distribution. It validates in-domain scalability and generalization to unseen catalog items, but does NOT establish cross-domain generalization to non-book domains or different e-commerce platform APIs.

prior_heldout_classification.reason: The previous 60-case held-out set was repeatedly inspected and used during system remediation and bug fixing (Package 7/8). It is retained as a regression benchmark, while this locked suite serves as the unbiased independent validation set.
